findings.title: Dual format self-improvement policy configuration files

evidence.observation: Both config/self_improvement_policy.json and config/self_improvement_policy.yaml exist simultaneously in repository.
YAML policy counterpart exists alongside JSON specification.

proposed_action.description: Standardize on a single configuration format for self_improvement_policy and remove the redundant configuration file.

findings.expected_benefit: Prevents configuration drift and establishes an unambiguous single source of truth for self-improvement rules.

findings.title: Uncommitted working tree modifications in intelligence and runtime paths

evidence.observation: Repository state is dirty with uncommitted changes in intelligence/proactive_cadences.py and platform_runtime.

proposed_action.description: Review, validate, and commit or stash uncommitted changes in intelligence/proactive_cadences.py and platform_runtime.

findings.expected_benefit: Ensures reproducible deployment state and clean version control tracking.
